stemMd: Which region had the largest percentage increase in e-bike sales from 2024 to 2025?
instructionsMd: Use only the figures shown. Work by hand.
explanationMd:
Percentage increase is the change divided by the 2024 figure:

$$\text{Alta } \tfrac{10}{40} = 25\% \quad \text{Bassa } \tfrac{10}{25} = 40\% \quad \text{Costa } \tfrac{6}{60} = 10\% \quad \text{Monti } \tfrac{9}{15} = 60\%$$

Monti grew fastest.

**The trap.** Monti's bars are the shortest on the chart and its absolute increase, 9 thousand, is not the largest. Alta and Bassa each added 10 thousand. A percentage change compares the increase with the starting level, and Monti started lowest.

distractorRationale.a: Alta added 10 thousand units, joint largest in absolute terms, but from a base of 40 thousand that is only 25 per cent.
distractorRationale.c: Bassa also added 10 thousand, and from 25 thousand that is 40 per cent: second-fastest, behind Monti's 60 per cent.
distractorRationale.b: Costa sells the most e-bikes in both years, but its increase of 6 thousand on 60 thousand is only 10 per cent, the slowest growth of the four.

accessibilityText: A question about the bar chart of e-bike sales by region in 2024 and 2025. It asks which region had the largest percentage increase. The options are the four regions: Alta, Bassa, Costa, Monti.

provenance.notes: Original item. Distractors are the largest absolute increases and the largest region.
